name: Mera Woods
source:
Oshea is missing. Her sister, Abessa, suspects she's disappeared into Mera Woods, a dangerous forest full of fairy creatures. Fearful, but determined, Abessa braves into the woods after her.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210125124220/http://renai.us/game/mera.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
奥希亚失踪了。她的妹妹阿贝莎怀疑她消失在梅拉森林中，这是一片充满仙女的危险森林。阿贝莎充满恐惧，但意志坚定，勇敢地追随她进入树林。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210125124220/http://renai.us/game/mera.shtml]仁爱档案[/url]]
